propositions: Rebar must add a first-class native AWS Bedrock provider using pydantic-ai's BedrockConverseModel, eliminating the need for an OpenAI-compatible gateway proxy.

Bedrock prompt caching must be wired with exactly two keys (bedrock_cache_instructions and bedrock_cache_tool_definitions) for parity with the direct Anthropic path, and rebar must warn when caching is requested but both cache_read and cache_write tokens are zero, indicating silent billing failure.

The Bedrock builder must omit temperature parameter for models where it is unsupported (e.g., us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7), tracked via a new supports_temperature capability, and 400 errors matching the sampling-parameter rejection pattern must translate to actionable LLMConfigError rather than systemic LLMUnavailableError.

Bedrock model access is account and region-scoped; us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 (regional inference profile) is the verified caching default, but on-demand model ids are not invokable in all environments and silent cache failures occur for some models like opus-4-5.

The Bedrock provider must be added as a new optional [bedrock] extra with boto3 included in dev but not in default [agents] install, and the builder must live in a separate src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py module to respect the 300-LOC cap on providers.py.
